PreToolUse.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input_json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tool = $input_json.tool_name; $cmd = $input_json.tool_input.command; $dangerous = @('prisma migrate reset','db push --force-reset','DROP TABLE','git push --force','git reset --hard','git clean -fd'); $blocked = $false; foreach ($d in $dangerous) { if ($cmd -like "*$d*") { $blocked = $true; break } }; if ($blocked) { $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; permissionDecision = 'ask'; permissionDecisionReason = "TWENTY2CRM Guardian: פעולה מסוכנת זוהתה! הפקודה '$cmd' עלולה לגרום נזק בלתי הפיך לנתוני הפרודקשן. אשר במפורש כדי להמשיך." } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; Write-Output $out; exit 0 } else { Write-Output '{"continue": true}'; exit 0 }"
PreToolUse.linux: bash -c 'input=$(cat); tool=$(echo $input | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_name\",\"\"))"); cmd=$(echo $input | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))"); for dangerous in "prisma migrate reset" "db push --force-reset" "DROP TABLE" "git push --force" "git reset --hard" "git clean -fd"; do if echo "$cmd" | grep -qi "$dangerous"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"TWENTY2CRM Guardian: פעולה מסוכנת זוהתה! אשר במפורש.\"}}"; exit 0; fi; done; echo "{\"continue\":true}"'
